validation.mechanic: Per-bullet power = (offense/5 + gun attack) x hit%[RoF] / 100
Defense split by RoF (club: full defense)
Damage <= 0 -> 1 (2 on a crit)
Graze x0.3, crit x1.5, splash x0.1
Hit bands: in range hit; 100-120% 80% graze; 120-150% 50%; 150-180% 25%; beyond miss
Crit chance 5/20/50% by distance (>80%, 50-80%, <50%) +20 with Critical
Club (actionId 8): no graze band, out of range = miss
Rocket splash (actionId 6): others hit if main hit; crit->hit, hit->graze, graze->splash
Burst: every live enemy in a ~90 degree cone, own distance roll
Attack All: one queue slot per target, each fires RoF bullets
Random Fire: RoF*3/2 bullets at random targets, defense split by RoF
Every bullet uses 1 round; empty magazine = shot clicks, reload at turn end
Status/elements only on a hit with damage > 0; Cyanide proc blocks the rest
Rocket launchers: no status, no elements (category 2)
Heat/Frost: resist /5, weak x1.5; Frost only if Heat not weak
Status chance: average 50%, strong never, weak always
Range in game units = 150 * sqrt(range stat + bonus)
ATB gain per tick = stat22 * factor[kind] / 10; full 9000; Slow -40%, Haste +50%
ATB factor by kind: hg 10, sg 8, mg 10, rifle 8, gl 8, rocket 4, Maeda 10, club 20
Animation loops by kind (windup, per-shot, recovery, hit frame)
Quickdraw: stat22 % chance of a full bar at battle start
Counter: after an enemy hit, chance L/1000 .. L/5000 by rank (L = HP level = level*10)
Tool transfer: bonuses add to destination (cap 999), source zeroed
Weapon stats, slots, built-in effects
